verdict.rationale: Exa documents natural-language web search over its own index, with latency-quality modes from instant to deep-reasoning. Websets also accept natural-language queries with criteria. A community user praises the search API, and another says SERP-style keyword results are the wrong interface for LLMs. However, the pack never explicitly describes embedding- or meaning-based retrieval or shows results keyword engines miss, and one hands-on GitHub repo search found only about 30% of what was requested. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of semantic/neural (embedding) retrieval, benchmarks or examples showing results keyword engines miss, consistent independent hands-on corroboration of retrieval quality.
